$comment: Per-system deploy overrides. Optional: discovery derives everything here from
where a folder sits (see src/core/deploy/discovery.ts), and this file only
changes the defaults. Listing them explicitly documents the mapping and gives
a single place to move one system to a different branch later.
Keys may be a system id ('demo:clinicos') or a bare slug, which applies to
productionBranch: the branch whose push triggers a deploy.
watchPaths: repo-relative globs; a commit touching none of them is ignored.
